boundaries: Process ru_maxrss is a per-process observed peak, not an externally sampled machine-lifetime peak.
Exact search uses saved float32 token vectors; no approximate index is used.
Effectiveness applies only to the two fixed English research tracks.
Training overlap is unknown; no verified zero-shot claim is allowed.

download.boundary: The successful ColBERT gate recorded zero incremental bytes because its snapshot was downloaded by an earlier failed semantic-validation attempt; conservative snapshot bytes are the defensible story total.
